claims.statement: learning-distill routes descriptive lessons (facts, rationale, architecture, troubleshooting patterns) to curated OKF pages under openwiki/{decisions,troubleshooting}/ and topical openwiki/ pages, and routes prescriptive lessons (agent behavior rules, procedures) to .agents/AGENTS.md or .agents/playbooks; descriptive never goes to .agents/ and prescriptive never goes to the wiki.

Distillation fails closed before any wiki write by verifying openspec and openwiki binaries on PATH via check_peer_tools.mjs and that openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md carries AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers; on failure it stops without writing and prints exact remediation (npm i -g commands or attach_wiki_contract.mjs / openwiki --init).

Canonical task/session identity is summary.json task_id, never the .agents/sessions/<bundle> folder name; folder names are sortable YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic labels and filtering prioritizes summary.json state fields distilled, status, distillation_status.

Per-task folders under .agents/sessions/ are gitignored via .agents/.gitignore entries sessions/* and !sessions/README.md (or root .gitignore equivalents); bundle discovery must be ignore-blind using filesystem listing (ls/find) or ripgrep --no-ignore-vcs, otherwise agents may falsely conclude no bundles exist.

Distillation never invokes openwiki --update; it authors wiki pages directly by loading runtime guidance from the globally installed package openwiki/dist/agent/prompt.js createSystemPrompt(init|update) and validates frontmatter via openwiki/dist/okf/frontmatter.js validateOkfFrontmatter, fixing every issue before continuing.

Wiki indexes are refreshed deterministically only via sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, which locates the global package via npm root -g, imports agent/docs-only-backend.js and okf/index-sync.js, constructs OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly:true virtualMode:true maxOutputBytes 100_000 timeout 120 and calls synchronizeWikiIndexes(backend, repository), keeping curated bodies byte-identical.

Skill initialization is idempotent and once per repo: ensures .agents/, .agents/playbooks/ and .agents/sessions/ exist, copies missing bootstrap README/AGENTS templates copy-missing-only, merges exactly sessions/* and !sessions/README.md into .agents/.gitignore, then runs peer-tool check and contract attachment; it no longer seeds any .agents/docs/ scaffold.

Allowed writes after prerequisites pass are limited to openwiki/decisions/*.md, openwiki/troubleshooting/*.md, openwiki/<topic>.md plus deterministic index sync, and .agents/AGENTS.md, .agents/playbooks/*.md, and the bundle summary.json distilled flags; it never writes OpenWiki-owned index.md/.last-update.json/.run.json except via sync, never writes openspec/ or source code, and never invents unsupported rules or copies secrets.

Curated pages follow OKF base fields type,title,description,tags,timestamp plus AKSK extensions aksk_status required on decision pages (accepted|superseded|provisional), optional aksk_superseded_by successor slug and optional aksk_depends_on list of qualified refs decisions/<slug> or troubleshooting/<slug>; additional aksk_* properties are allowed and preserved round-trip.

Entry identity is the filename stem lowercase [a-z0-9_-] unique within its tree; filenames carry no type prefix, disambiguation is via qualified references and relative Markdown links, and renames must update all inbound aksk_depends_on/aksk_superseded_by references.

If a candidate decision restates a SHALL requirement already codified in openspec/specs/, distillation must not create or extend a wiki page and must cite the spec capability instead; procedure requires grep over openwiki/ and, for decision-shaped candidates, over openspec/specs/ before authoring.

Curation contract attachment is owned by attach_wiki_contract.mjs which reads references/wiki-contract-template.md verbatim bounded by AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT BEGIN/END markers; it appends below existing content if absent (stub-aware), no-ops if already equal, refreshes only between markers on template change, and exits 2 with openwiki --init if openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md does not exist.
Curation contract declares preserve-and-link curated trees; aksk_* frontmatter survives round-trips. Write decisions/troubleshooting only via this skill's deterministic index refresh.

Procedure order is locate bundle ignore-blind, search existing knowledge and deduplicate, classify per six-category table (ephemeral, AGENTS guidance, playbook, decision, troubleshooting, descriptive lesson), author wiki pages directly with OKF validation, draft minimal .agents updates, run sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, then mark summary.json distilled:true and distillation_status; there is no separate log file and accountability is bundle flags plus git history.

Task-closeout writes exactly five files per bundle (summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, validation.txt) under .agents/sessions/<session-folder>/ and the bundle is immutable after closeout except for distilled/distillation_status in summary.json; closeout never edits wiki, durable docs, playbooks, or openspec/ in-flight.
